title: NAVEE NT5 Ultra X Dual-Motor Electric Scooter
body_html:
Performance Without the Drama

The NAVEE NT5 Ultra X brings serious dual-motor performance, long-range capability, and light off-road versatility into a refined platform built for everyday riding.

Powered by dual motors producing up to 2400W combined peak power, the NT5 Ultra X delivers strong acceleration and confident climbing performance while retaining the stability and comfort you want for longer rides.

Add front and rear suspension, extra-wide 10.5-inch tubeless tires, a large 898Wh-class battery, dual disc brakes, traction control, smart connectivity, and a full lighting package, and you've got one seriously capable all-rounder.

40 MPH Performance

The US-market NT5 Ultra X is capable of speeds up to approximately 40 mph, putting it firmly into performance-scooter territory.

Whether you're opening it up on a longer stretch or navigating a steep climb, dual-motor drive gives the NT5 Ultra X the power and traction to keep moving.

Dual 1200W Peak Motors

Two motors deliver up to:

1200W × 2 Peak Power

2400W Combined Peak Power

Dual-wheel drive improves acceleration, climbing capability, and traction when the terrain gets more demanding.

Up to 56 Miles of Range

NAVEE's high-capacity battery and NavUltrange™ efficiency technology are engineered to maximize distance between charges.

Maximum advertised range reaches approximately:

56 miles at 9.3 mph under controlled test conditions

Real-world range varies significantly based on riding speed, rider weight, hills, temperature, tire pressure, acceleration, and riding style.

Built to Climb

With dual-motor power and up to approximately 45% climbing capability under NAVEE's published global specifications, the NT5 Ultra X is built for routes that would challenge an ordinary commuter scooter.

Front + Rear Suspension

The NT5 Ultra X combines:

Front Dual Telescopic Suspension

with

Rear Damping Arm™ Suspension

The suspension system helps isolate the rider from potholes, broken pavement, expansion joints, gravel, and uneven terrain.

With approximately 40 mm of suspension travel, the NT5 Ultra X is equally at home tackling imperfect city streets or heading beyond smooth pavement.

10.5" Extra-Wide Tubeless Tires

Large 10.5-inch × 80 mm tubeless tires create a wider contact patch for increased stability and confident handling.

The all-terrain-oriented tire design makes the NT5 Ultra X capable of moving comfortably between pavement and light off-road surfaces.

Triple Braking System

Performance is only useful when you can control it.

The NT5 Ultra X combines:

  • Front 140 mm disc brake
  • Rear 140 mm disc brake
  • EABS electronic braking

The combination delivers strong, progressive stopping power for higher-speed riding.

Traction Control System

NAVEE's integrated TCS — Traction Control System helps reduce wheelspin and maintain traction on loose or slippery surfaces.

It's especially useful when accelerating hard, climbing, or riding on changing terrain.

Smart Lighting From Every Angle

The NT5 Ultra X includes:

6W Auto-Sensing Headlight
Automatically reacts to ambient lighting conditions and provides up to approximately 25 meters of illumination.

Integrated Turn Signals
Handlebar-mounted indicators improve visibility when changing direction.

Rear Brake Light
Provides additional visibility to riders and vehicles behind you.

5-Inch Display

A large 5-inch LED display keeps essential riding information easy to see while you're moving.

Smart NAVEE App

Connect your scooter to the NAVEE App for compatible smart features, ride information, security controls, and vehicle settings.

The NT5 Ultra X also supports:

  • Bluetooth connectivity
  • Apple Find My
  • FlyLock technology
  • Smart BMS
  • Traction Control System

Auto Unlock

With compatible FlyLock functionality enabled, the scooter can recognize your phone as you approach and automatically unlock for a more seamless start to your ride.

IPX6 Water Resistance

With an IPX6 water-resistance rating, the NT5 Ultra X is engineered to handle changing everyday weather conditions.

Water resistance does not mean waterproof, and the scooter should never be submerged.

Built for Bigger Riders

With a maximum rated payload of approximately 331 lb / 150 kg, the NT5 Ultra X offers substantially more carrying capacity than many conventional commuter scooters.

Key Specifications

Top Speed: Up to 40 mph — US market

Peak Motor Power: 1200W × 2 / 2400W combined

Drive: Dual Motor / Dual-Wheel Drive

Battery: 46.8V / approximately 898.56Wh

Maximum Advertised Range: Up to 56 miles at 9.3 mph under controlled conditions

Maximum Incline: Up to 45%

Suspension: Front Dual Telescopic + Rear Damping Arm™

Suspension Travel: Approx. 40 mm

Tires: 10.5" × 80 mm Tubeless All-Terrain Tires

Brakes: Front & Rear 140 mm Disc Brakes + EABS

Maximum Payload: 331 lb / 150 kg

Net Weight: Approx. 80.5 lb / 36.5 kg

Headlight: 6W Auto-Sensing

Turn Signals: Integrated

Display: 5" LED

Water Resistance: IPX6

Bluetooth: Yes

NAVEE App: Yes

Apple Find My: Yes

TCS: Yes

FlyLock: Yes

title: MIA SPYQE ATV Electric Scooter
body_html:
Conquer city chaos with the MIA SPYQE 2X4. Featuring dual hub motors, 25 mph top speed, hydraulic disc brakes, and foldable portability, this electric scooter delivers safe, smooth, and powerful urban commuting—built for real riders.

Tired of City Commutes That Drain You? Meet the MIA SPYQE | Two-wheel drive (2X4)

The Electric Scooter for Urban Commuting That Turns Urban Chaos Into Smooth Commuting

Stuck dodging potholes, fighting for sidewalk space, or sweating over unreliable public transport? Most scooters leave you stressed and stranded. The MIA SPYQE | Two-wheel drive (2X4) was built for real commuters - those who need to outsmart city chaos, skip gridlock, and get through the day without a single “What now?” moment. You get steady rides, lasting power, and a design that keeps up with every part of your day.

Tech That Solves Commuting Frustration

Leave Unstable, Wobbly Scooters Behind

Every bump and pothole on the way to work can turn a simple trip into a struggle. Two-wheeled scooters tip and wobble on rough ground, making each ride unpredictable. The SPYQE solves this problem with a stable four-wheel setup and wide 12-inch tires. Instead of bracing for every crack, you move steadily through the city. Your focus stays on the road ahead, not on keeping your scooter upright.

title: MIA FOUR X2 ATV ElectricScooter
body_html:
Four-wheel stability. Two-wheel-drive agility. Fully electric performance.

The MIA FOUR X2 is a stand-up electric ATV scooter engineered for riders who want greater stability without sacrificing speed or responsive handling. Its patented tilting four-wheel platform and independent suspension help the scooter remain composed across broken pavement, gravel, grass and other uneven surfaces.

Powered by a 3,600W peak dual-hub motor system, the X2 delivers strong acceleration and capable climbing performance. Its removable 60V 25Ah LG battery provides up to 50 miles of range under optimal riding conditions and can be swapped to extend your adventure. MIA Dynamics USA

Built to Go Beyond the Pavement

Four wide 14.5-inch tires create a stable, confidence-inspiring platform, while the two-wheel-drive configuration keeps the X2 lighter and more agile than the MIA FOUR X4. Full suspension absorbs bumps and vibrations, allowing you to navigate city streets, dirt paths, gravel roads and recreational trails with greater control.

Lean naturally into turns using MIA’s patented tilting system for a riding experience that combines the responsiveness of a scooter with the planted feel of an ATV.

Power Without Range Anxiety

The 3,600W peak BLDC dual-hub motor provides the power needed for fast acceleration and inclines, while the 60V 25Ah removable battery delivers up to 50 miles of claimed range per charge. The battery uses LG 21700 cells and can be removed for convenient indoor charging or replaced with a charged spare.

Actual speed and range will vary according to rider weight, terrain, riding speed, tire pressure, temperature and battery condition. MIA Dynamics USA specifications

Confident Braking and Visibility

Specialized front and rear hydraulic disc brakes with 140mm rotors provide smooth, responsive stopping power. Dual LED headlights, an integrated taillight and a brake light improve visibility when riding in low-light conditions.

Foldable and Customizable

The folding handlebar reduces the X2’s height to approximately 17.7 inches, making storage and transportation easier. Its modular platform supports optional accessories including a seat and saddle, rear cargo carrier, utility box, golf-bag carrier, trailer hitch and mobility-chair attachment.

Key Features

  • Four-wheel stand-up ATV scooter platform
  • Two-wheel-drive 2×4 configuration
  • 3,600W peak BLDC dual-hub motors
  • Up to 50-mile claimed range
  • Removable and swappable 60V 25Ah LG battery
  • 14.5-inch indoor/outdoor tires
  • Patented tilting and full-suspension system
  • Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes
  • Dual LED headlights, taillight and brake light
  • Folding handlebar for easier storage
  • Maximum recommended rider load of 300 lb
  • Modular accessory mounting system

Technical Specifications

Drivetrain Two-wheel drive, 2×4
Motor 3,600W peak BLDC dual-hub motor
Advertised maximum capability 45+ mph
US factory speed limit 25 mph

Battery cells LG 21700 50MT

title: NAVEE ST3 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
Your smartest commute starts here. The NAVEE ST3 Pro is a premium commuter scooter engineered for riders who want serious range, a smooth ride, and smart connectivity — without stepping into full performance territory. With a 600W rated motor (1350W peak), self-sealing tubeless tires, dual damping arm suspension, and Apple Find My built in, the ST3 Pro is ready for everything your daily route throws at it.

Why the ST3 Pro?

  • Up to 46.6 miles of range on a single charge — or ~28 miles at a brisk 20 mph
  • Self-sealing tubeless tires automatically seal small punctures, keeping you rolling
  • Dual Damping Arm suspension front and rear for a noticeably smoother ride
  • Triple braking system: front drum + rear disc + EABS for confident, controlled stops
  • Apple Find My integration — locate your scooter anytime from your iPhone
  • TCS traction control for stable, confident starts on any surface
  • Tackle inclines up to 28% with ease
  • IPX5 water resistance for worry-free riding in light rain

Performance Specifications

  • Motor: 600W rated / 1350W peak
  • Top Speed: 24.9 mph
  • Maximum Range: 46.6 miles (at ~9 mph) / ~28 miles (at 20 mph)
  • Battery: 48V 12.75Ah / 596.7Wh
  • Charging Time: ~10 hours
  • Maximum Incline: 28%

Build & Comfort

  • Tires: 10-inch self-sealing tubeless
  • Suspension: Dual Damping Arm (front & rear)
  • Brakes: Front drum + rear disc + EABS
  • Water Resistance: IPX5
  • Product Weight: 55.8 lbs
  • Maximum Load: 265 lbs

Smart & Security Features

  • NAVEE App (iOS & Android)
  • Apple Find My
  • TCS Traction Control System

Key Highlights

  • ✔ 46.6-mile maximum range
  • ✔ 600W rated / 1350W peak motor
  • ✔ Self-sealing tubeless tires
  • ✔ Dual Damping Arm suspension (front & rear)
  • ✔ Triple braking: drum + disc + EABS
  • ✔ Apple Find My built-in
  • ✔ TCS traction control
  • ✔ IPX5 water resistance
  • ✔ 28% maximum incline

title: NAVEE G5 Max Electric Scooter

Go the distance — without compromise. The NAVEE G5 Max is built for riders who demand real-world range, smart security, and a smooth ride on every commute. With a 500W rated motor (1000W peak), 10-inch tubeless tires, and front-and-rear suspension, it handles city streets and longer routes with equal confidence.

Why the G5 Max?

  • Cover up to 43.5 miles on a single charge — one of the longest ranges in its class
  • Apple Find My integration keeps your scooter locatable at all times
  • Bluetooth smart lock — secure your ride directly from your phone

title: 60V Fast Charger Kaabo Connector
body_html:
Up to 5A fast charger for your electric scooter. Reduce charging time by more than 50%. Max voltage 67.2 for electric scooters with 60V system and upgraded Kaabo connector.

Advanced Charging controls: Decide if you want to trickle charge or fast charge by adjusting the Ampere setting from 1-5. Choose your target charging level of 80%, 90% or 100%. The charger will only charge up to the selected level.

Display: Both voltage and current are shown during the charging process.

Automatic charge optimization: When the battery is around 80%, the constant current phase is completed and the current measured in Ampere will drop. This is the beginning of the constant voltage phase which will charge at lower current until it automatically stops at 100%.

Dual Input Voltage: Choose input voltage depending on your location (110V or 240V). Preset to 110V for US.

Dimensions of "charger brick": 9x2.25x3.5 inches.

Please double check the connector on your scooter before you buy 

For Kaabo WOLF X GT, Kaabo MANTIS KING GT, and other Kaabo 60V scooters with the new connector.

title: fluid VISTA
body_html:
Meet the fluid VISTA - a brand new electric scooter for demanding riders looking for quick and powerful acceleration, long range, and indestructible build quality for rough city streets, all at phenomenal value.

Quite unique in this segment, it runs on a punchy 60V system with a quiet smooth-running 1000W rear motor and highly responsive controller set up resulting in ZERO deadzone on the thumb throttle for speedy take offs and quick hill-climbs. The 31mph top speed feel stable and safe. Two battery options are available: a large 858Wh (14.5Ah) battery and an extra large 1260WH (21Ah) battery offering up to 45 and 65 miles of range, respectively, under optimal conditions. 

The extra large center display shows key riding info like current speed, mileage, voltage and power output right where you need it. Three riding modes plus a walking speed option are accessible during your ride. The included App let's you customize your riding profile with options for setting zero start, speed settings for the riding modes, initial acceleration and much more. 

In the spirit of making this a hassle free commuter scooter, we outfitted the VISTA with front and rear solid tires so you will never have a flat. The front and rear preload adjustable suspension compensates for the solid tires and delivers an overall smooth riding experience. 

The VISTA is ready for riding in traffic, during the night and when it rains. The complete lighting package includes a bright front headlight, lateral and rear LED lights as well as turn signals. With no-splash front and rear fenders and an IPx5 rating there is no worry when it rains.

At 60 lbs it is no lightweight but it sits on the road like a tank, giving you confidence at higher speeds. I folds down with a rock-solid lever-style folding mechanism and can be carried in one hand.

title: NAMI KLIMA
body_html:
Meet the NAMI KLIMA - the brand new development from the makers of the record breaking Burn-E. With best in class torque for a speedy take off, fully customizable controls, adjustable suspension, supreme handling and stability, as well as full lighting and waterproofing, all at an attractive price point, this is the contender for the best performance scooter of 2023.

The most notable feature is the supremely designed drivetrain with dual 1000W brushless hub motors, that work in perfect harmony with the dual 40A sine wave controllers. Together they deliver best in class torque straight from take-off, outperforming key competitive scooters. The excellent torque is slightly compromising top speed which still clocks in at an impressive GPS measured 42 mph. Throttle response is smooth enough for a walking speed talk off in full power mode. And, cherry on the top, the motors deliver a silent riding experience.

There are two battery options, the standard version comes with a large 25Ah battery with range expectations of 50 miles while the MAX version comes with 30Ah featuring LG 21700 cells which can deliver up to 60 miles (range under optimal conditions, 165 lb rider, 15-20mph constant speed).

The Riding experience is second to none - the dual rebound adjustable suspension (KKE coil shocks) in combination with the tubeless extra wide 10” tires and the low center of gravity deliver a smooth and stable ride, both at high speeds and going off road. The Logan two piston hydraulic brakes with the 160mm rotors put superior stopping power at your fingertips. Also at your fingertips on the right side are the riding controls from a smooth thumb-throttle, to the loud horn, 2000 lumen ultra-bright headlight and turn signals operating the bright rear facing LED strip. On your left hand side is the riding mode selector that also operates the bright center display which allows for advanced customization of 5 riding modes to fit your preferred riding styles.

Quality build and thoughtful engineering is visible throughout the entire scooter: The one piece aircraft grade aluminum deck is welded to perfection, long enough for a comfortable stance, and comes with a rear-foot rest for better riding stability. The battery is fully sealed inside the deck to be fully waterproof. The waterproof controllers live in an easily accessible, separate casing in the neck above the deck, which, in combination with the integrated cooling fins on the motors, prevent overheating during your most demanding rides. With an overall IP 55 rating and splash-proof front and rear fenders, your new KLIMA is safe to ride in the rain.

If you are looking for a high end performance scooter just over the $2,000 mark with best-in class torque and excellent ride quality, that ticks all the boxes, the brand new NAMI KLIMA is for you!

With only 29 lbs, this lightweight and foldable electric scooter is right for everyone who needs a compact and portable scooter but does not want to compromise on performance. Bright front and rear LED lights, the lateral reflectors, and the loud electric horn allow for safe riding in traffic and during the night. The triple braking system features an electric "throttle" brake which recharges your battery on the go, a lever pulled rear drum brake, and rear step on brake for overall excellent stopping power.

Your cockpit is complemented by a smooth thumb throttle and a color display showing speed, mileage and battery charge. It allows for selection of 5 "gears" with different speed limits so you can, for instance, set it 16 mph top speed to comply with local laws or maximize your range. Cruise control and zero start can be set up if desired.  

If you are looking for an ultra-portable and versatile scooter that is fast enough to take over bicycles and rental scooters, the Mosquito is the right choice for you.

title: Mantis King GT
body_html:
The Kaabo Mantis has been a staple of the scooter industry for years. Kaabo has come back this year with a brand-new take on a fan favorite. The new Kaabo Mantis King GT is that next step forward in terms of design and performance. Thrilling dual motor acceleration up to 43 mph top speed, 56 miles range under optimal conditions, adjustable dual suspension, a sturdy chassis, and an all new cockpit with a bright center console display make a the GT a contender for the best performance scooter on the market. 

Starting from the ground, the original Mantis has been redesigned. The Kaabo Mantis King GT now comes with wider 10” x 3” pneumatic tires, available in street and off-road configuration. These great new tires are wrapped around dual 1100W hub motors that deliver 4200W peak output in combination a pair of 60V 30A sinewave controllers. These controllers are not only more powerful than the outgoing PRO model but much smoother as well with their increased signal refinement for controllable and smooth acceleration. 

These power-hungry controllers draw off an equivalently capable 60V 24Ah battery with 21700 Samsung cells,  promising a  tested 37 mile range under real world conditions. This is the type of distance perfect for a hardcore commuter looking to ditch the car and public transportation or a recreational rider looking for an entire day worth of adventure. Not only can your ride take you wherever you want to go but it can also happen during most weather conditions with the Mantis King GT coming with an IPX5 water resistance rating.

The dual suspension is fully adjustable for rebound and preload and is a first for this class of scooter. It converts the Mantis King GT from off-road scalpel to rugged commuter to high speed racer, depending on user setup. The excellent handling characteristics are bolstered further by an all new super secure double action rigid folding mechanism found at the base of the stem.

The scooter comes in at a weigh of 74 pounds, while being strong enough to support up to 265 pounds. The deck itself is slightly longer and wider than the previous models which just adds to rider comfort. Ground clearance is also boosted to 5.8 inches offering the ability to clear a large variety of obstacles both on and off road. 

Moving up to the now wider 660mm stability enhancing handlebars we find best in class user controls which include horn, turn signals and lighting. The light control activates all the lighting at once. These include a high mounted bright LED headlight which increases rider safety and visibility, bright deck button lights, and app programmable RGB lights on the side panels. The turn signals activate separate led button lights in the deck which indicate your intentions both front and rear and can be used as hazard together. The horn button engages the loud electronic horn housed in the headlight unit.

The star of the show is the 4.2” TFT display which is bright enough to be read in direct sunlight and offers riders and astounding array of information about their scooter, how it is currently functioning and access to adjustments to tailor the Mantis King GT’s power to their riding style. 

Available with street and off-road tires.

Bright front and rear LED lights, the lateral reflectors, and the loud electric horn allow for safe riding in traffic and during the night. The triple braking system features an electric "throttle" brake which recharges your battery on the go, a lever pulled rear drum brake, and rear step on brake for overall excellent stopping power.

Your cockpit is complemented by a smooth thumb throttle and a color display showing speed, mileage and battery charge. It allows for selection of 5 "gears" with different speed limits so you can, for instance, set it 16 mph top speed to comply with local laws or maximize your range. Cruise control and zero start can be set up if desired.  

If you are looking for an ultra-portable and versatile scooter that is fast enough to take over bicycles and rental scooters, the Mosquito is the right choice for you.

Meet the BURN-E 2, the more affordable version of the innovative Burn E 2 Max from NAMI*. Two 1000W motors with a peak output of over 5000W in combination with the sinwave controllers deliver thrilling acceleration up to 45mph. Equipped with a large 72V 28Ah battery, the BURN-E can reach a maximum range of 90 miles (constant 18mph, 160 lb rider) and a real world tested range of over 60 miles.

The LOGAN full hydraulic 160mm disc brakes, combined with the integrated electric brake with adjustable intensity, will offer reliable handling and strong stopping power.

Paying specific attention to the community, NAMI integrated innovative technology in its newest scooter. The BURN-E features a large, waterproof smart display which lets riders adjust many settings according to their preferences. You can choose between 5 different ride modes including turbo mode for extra power and fun. On top of that, you can independently adjust the acceleration strength of the front and rear motor and the intensity of the electric brake.

Two adjustable 165mm hydraulic coil-shock suspensions and 11-inch tubeless 90/65-6.5 tires (off-road tires available separately) make for a smooth ride in any terrain. A powerful 2000 lumen headlight, side LED strips and a rear brake light are part of the all-round lighting system for a safe commute in the dark.

High-quality parts from its core to the details make the BURN-E one of the most interesting scooters in its class.

A heat-treated aviation grade welding frame in one piece, a full carbon fiber steering column and polished stainless steel parts give the scooter its robust structure, designed for high speeds and durability.

Weighing just under 100 lb, the BURN-E is a bit lighter that comparable models in its class and has a newly designed wobble free folding mechanism which allows a relatively compact transportation.

Typically, when battery packs break early on in their lives, it is due to failing electronics in the BMS (Battery Management System). Instead of discarding the entire pack with sometimes hundreds of high value cells, we take the pack apart, test each individual cell and give the working cells a new life.

The result is this battery pack, for charging your phone or other devices. Since our electric scooter batteries consist of higher quality cells than typical power banks, you can expect first class performance and durability. And most importantly, we get to reduce waste...

Capacity varying based on cells used. Minimum capacity quoted below based on our lowest capacity 2500 mAh cells.

title: NAMI BURN-E 3 MAX
body_html:
Meet the BURN-E 3 Max, the latest iteration of the innovative and record-breaking scooter from NAMI*. Developed based on community requests and feedback, the BURN-E eliminates the weak points of other scooters in the ultra-high performance category and delivers a smooth, powerful and safe riding experience.

Two powerful 1500W motors with a peak output of 8400W in combination with the 50A sinewave controllers deliver awesome torque and thrilling acceleration up to 70mph. Equipped with a large 72V 40Ah battery with branded Li-ion cells (LG 21700), the BURN-E can reach a maximum range of 115 miles (constant 18mph, 160 lb rider) and a realistic range of around 50-60 miles.

Similarly powerful as the motors are its 4-piston LOGAN full hydraulic 160mm disc brakes. Combined with the integrated electric brake with adjustable intensity, they reliably bring the scooter to a halt.

Paying specific attention to the community, NAMI integrated innovative technology in its newest scooter. The BURN-E 3 Max features a large, waterproof smart display which lets riders adjust many settings according to their preferences. You can choose between 5 different ride modes including turbo mode for extra power and fun. On top of that, you can independently adjust the acceleration strength of the front and rear motor and the intensity of the electric brake.

Two adjustable 165mm hydraulic coil-shock suspensions and 11-inch tubeless 90/65-6.5 tires (off-road tires available separately) make for a smooth ride in any terrain. A powerful 2000 lumen headlight, side LED strips and a rear brake light are part of the all-round lighting system for a safe commute in the dark.

High-quality parts from its core to the details make the BURN-E 3 Max one of the most interesting scooters in its class.

 

A heat-treated aviation grade welding frame in one piece, a full carbon fiber steering column and polished stainless steel parts give the scooter its robust structure, designed for high speeds and durability.

Weighing a proud 103 lb, the BURN-E 3 Max is a bit lighter than comparable models in its class and has a newly designed wobble free folding mechanism which allows a relatively compact transportation.

* Improvements vs the original Burn-E: 4-piston hydraulic brakes, added waterproof motor connectors for better serviceability, improved charging ports, includes 5A charger, improved turn-signals, wider 27 inch handlebar.

body_html:
The fluid Electric Longboard is perfect for anybody who is looking for a fun and exciting commute. With only 17 pounds, its two rear 350W motors will reach a top speed of 23 mph. The 6Ah Samsung battery realistically promises 15-20 miles of range.

Beautifully designed, the multi-layer bamboo and maple board offers the perfect balance between stability and flexibility. The grip tape on the deck ensures a permanent contact between feet and board for maximum riding control at any time. The design of the deck allows the rider to lean in to curves without the board touching the wheels. A carrying handle, integrated in the deck, makes it easy to quickly carry the board over train tracks or up a flight of stairs.

The portable skateboard is easy to store under any table or bed.

The soft PU-wheels allow the rider to smoothly and quietly glide along asphalt and tackle cracks and even smaller bumps in the road. It is water resistant and can be used in any conditions as long as the battery is never submerged fully under water.

The ESC-remote (Electronic Speed Control) comfortably lies in the hand and gives the rider easy access to all features with the thumb. You can choose between three speed modes ranging from a cruise mode for the beginner to a high speed mode for the advanced rider. A forward and backward switch lets you choose between the regular and goofy position. The speed control offers extremely smooth and predictable acceleration and braking, necessary to maintain the balance on the board.

The box includes a multitool for quick and easy maintenance, nose and tail guards to protect the wood, and two replacement pads which seal the controller and battery (should they ever need to be opened).

Reinvent your commute - The Fluid Board is the perfect choice to reach your destination in style. It is delivered fully equipped, charged up and ready to ride!

title: 60V Fast Charger
body_html:
Up to 5A fast charger for your electric scooter. Reduce charging time by more than 50%. Max voltage 67.2 for electric scooters with 60V system and GX16 3-pin connector.
Advanced Charging controls: Decide if you want to trickle charge or fast charge by adjusting the Ampere setting from 1-5. Choose your target charging level of 80%, 90% or 100%. The charger will only charge up to the selected level.

Display: Both voltage and current are shown during the charging process.

Automatic charge optimization: When the battery is around 80%, the constant current phase is completed and the current measured in Ampere will drop. This is the beginning of the constant voltage phase which will charge at lower current until it automatically stops at 100%.

Dual Input Voltage: Choose input voltage depending on your location (110V or 240V). Preset to 110V for US.

Dimensions of "charger brick": 9x2.25x3.5 inches.

For 60V WOLF, MANTIS, Dualtron, and many other electric scooters (check images for polarity). Not compatible with Mantis King GT.

Not recommended for batteries under 15Ah.

title: MANTIS 2025 - fluid Edition
body_html:
The Kaabo MANTIS electric scooter just got better: With a new lighting package, full hydraulic brakes, and IPx5 waterproofing, it is designed for the demanding rider who wants it all! Swift inner city commutes with strong acceleration, excellent trail performance for those fun weekend rides, up to 45 miles between charges, and still allows carrying in one hand.

With 65 pounds this scooter is one of the lightest in its class. It folds down easily and is still portable, despite its strong performance. 

The two powerful brushless 60V 1000W motors deliver fun acceleration and climb up to 30% inclines with ease. Ride in single motor mode up to 30 mph while conserving your battery or switch on the second motor for extra acceleration and 40 mph top speed.

The front and rear advanced swing arm spring suspension delivers a smooth ride on any terrain. Ride over grass or on dirt trails, jump a curb in the city, this 40 mph electric scooter can handle pretty much any reasonable ground condition.

Dual hydraulic disc brakes provide full control during your ride. The advanced display/throttle combination allows configuration of speed limit, cruise control and regenerative braking strength. 

The brand new bright headlight at handlebar height lights up the road ahead of you while the two front and rear LEDs plus the bright lateral LED strips inside ensure you will be seen at night. The newly added turn-signals and horn make for safe riding in traffic.

Charge overnight with the included charger in 10-12h. 5A Fast Charger available to reduce charging time by 60-70%.

Available with 18.2Ah standard battery or 24.5Ah LG/Samsung battery for more range. Also available as the fully re-designed MANTIS King GT, with new cockpit and 30A controllers (vs. 25A Kaabo controllers in this model).

Satisfaction guaranteed!
